title: DEFENSE_EQUIPMENT_V1
description: Standard W3C Verifiable Credential Schema for Military Hardware, Radars, Avionics & Electronic Warfare Assets

equipmentSerialNo.description: Unique Ordnance / Military Equipment Serial Number, e.g. BEL-RADAR-3D-CAR-042

equipmentName.description: Official military nomenclature, e.g. '3D Central Acquisition Radar (Rohini)'

manufacturingUnit.description: BEL Production Plant (e.g. 'BEL Bengaluru Complex / Ghaziabad Unit')

custodianUnit.description: Active military regiment or air base, e.g. 'IAF 48 Squadron, Ambala AFS'

custodianDID.description: Decentralized Identifier (DID) of commanding officer / custodian unit
